Is Lautaro Martínez already a top-five Inter striker? Our pick: Lautaro — already No. 2, behind only Meazza.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate10 — the Italian Inter press in English every morning, free
THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.
Lautaro Martínez, 2018– (No. 10, captain since 2023): 181 goals in 384 games for Inter, third on the club's all-time list; 3 Scudetti (2020–21, 2023–24, 2025–26), 3 Coppa Italia, 3 Supercoppa; Capocannoniere 2023–24 (24 goals) and 2025–26 (17); Inter's all-time leading Champions League scorer.
Alessandro Altobelli, 1977–88: 209 goals in 466 games, second all-time; Scudetto 1979–80, Coppa Italia 1978 and 1982; Cup Winners' Cup top scorer 1978–79; 1982 World Cup winner, scorer in the final; never Serie A top scorer.
Giuseppe Meazza 284 goals (1927–47) · Roberto Boninsegna 171 (1969–76, Capocannoniere 1971 and 1972) · Sandro Mazzola 161 (1960–77) · Christian Vieri 123 (1999–2005).
Sources: inter.it (all-time top scorers, updated Oct 13, 2026; player page), Wikipedia, beIN Sports
